Texas Housing Market August 2025: Racism, Price Cuts & Foreclosure
The Texas housing market is shifting fast in August 2025 — with falling home prices, rising foreclosures, and surprising trends you need to know. In this video, we break down the latest real estate data from Houston, Austin, San Antonio, and beyond.
We’ll cover:
🏠 Current Texas home prices & price cuts
📉 What’s really causing more foreclosures
⚠️ Discrimination & racism in the housing market
📊 Inventory, mortgage rates, and buyer demand in August 2025
📍 Which Texas cities are still hot… and which are cooling fast

Whether you’re a homebuyer, seller, investor, or just curious about the Texas real estate market, this update will give you the facts and expert insights you won’t hear anywhere else.

Grab your 100% FREE weekly report for your local market here: https://altos.re/keep-informed?a=6460...

Get a free 1-on-1 strategy call with our team → https://realestatesteph.co
We'll break down your local market, run the numbers, and give you a game plan tailored to YOU.

📊 Want to know if your area is overpriced? Drop your zip code in the comments and I’ll reply with insights from the data!

👀 Like the video? Smash that 👍 and subscribe for more Texas housing updates
